name: poly_ratfunc_fermat_curve_const
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (f g : RatFunc k) (heq : f ^ n + g ^ n = 1) : (∃ c : k, f = RatFunc.C c) ∧ (∃ d : k, g = RatFunc.C d)
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (f g : RatFunc k) (heq : f ^ n + g ^ n = 1), (∃ c : k, f = RatFunc.C c) ∧ (∃ d : k, g = RatFunc.C d)
informal: The Fermat curve x^n + y^n = 1 (n ≥ 3) has no non-constant rational parametrisation in char 0 — write f = a/c, g = b/c with common denominator, cancel gcd(a,b,c) to get pairwise coprime a^n + b^n = c^n, then Uses Mathlib2.ms_flt_poly to conclude a, b, c constant; the cases a = 0 or b = 0 (g^n = 1 forces g constant) are separate.
type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → ∀ (f g : RatFunc k), f ^ n + g ^ n = 1 → (∃ c, f = RatFunc.C c) ∧ ∃ d, g = RatFunc.C d
